name: Locke
notes: Casts go one at a time: Purgatory (0.25s cast time), Ritual Nails and each of its free recasts (0.25s each), and Ashen Pursuit's blink (0.5s) all keep Locke busy for that long, during which no other cast starts and no attack lands; Soul Ignition has no cast time of its own but still waits for any cast in progress before it fires.

Opens with Purgatory (R) at t=0: its 0.25s cast time elapses first, then (independent of that busy period) the totem travels 0.5s and, after a further 0.25s landing delay, fires its magic nail damage 0.75s after the cast started; if the target's health is then at or below the execute threshold, a true-damage execute resolves in the same instant (the dossier leaves this timing open; instant resolution on the same hit is the simplest and most common reading).

Once Purgatory's cast time is over, Ritual Nails (Q) is cast (0.25s cast time) and both free recasts are taken back-to-back at their fixed 0.5s intervals (unaffected by haste; each recast is likewise treated as a 0.25s cast that waits behind any other cast in progress) to land all three nails and reach 3 Soul Nails stacks as fast as possible; the ability's cooldown starts when the last recast lands (post-effect).

Soul Ignition (W) is cast the instant it is off cooldown and no other cast is in progress, purely for its attack-speed buff; its grey-health banking, heal-on-recast, and mana/health costs are not modeled (irrelevant to a damage race against a stationary dummy, and not plausible to bind casts inside 15s at this rank).

Every basic attack applies Silver Stake's (P) bonus magic on-hit, scaled continuously from +10% AP (0% target missing health) up to +20% AP (70%+ missing health, capping there per the wiki's stated formula), and also consumes any live Soul Nails stacks for their bonus damage if present.

Ashen Pursuit (E) is cast on cooldown as soon as it is free of any other cast in progress: its blink deals damage on cast and keeps Locke busy for its 0.5s cast time; 0.1s after the cast started (independent of the cast-time busy period, per the dossier's fixed delay), the empowered dash lands separately, dealing its own damage and applying the same on-hit effects (Silver Stake plus Soul Nails consumption); the dash itself has no cast time and does not touch the attack timer, matching the wiki's note that it is not a basic attack.
Locke's permanent Sealed Champion stacks (from prior kills, raising R's execute threshold) are assumed to be 0 for a level-16 damage fight with no prior takedowns.
W's cooldown array uses the ddragon/wiki-agreeing values [18,17,16,15,14] rather than the bin's disagreeing [20,18,16,14,12].

assumed.why: permanent execute-threshold stacks earned by prior kills; a fresh damage-dummy fight has none

the wiki infobox's 0.5s is the totem's travel/queue time to the target location, not the champion-locking cast animation; the bin's 0.25s castTime field is used as the actual cast time that keeps Locke busy
